name: brewmod-reminders
description: Brewmod reminders -- durable file-based reminders (check prod tomorrow 09:00) that survive sessions: band at session start, offered at the first prompt, nothing runs unasked (Claude Code 2.1.301+ mod)

prefix.title: Reminder picker prefix
prefix.description: 2-8 ASCII punctuation characters that open the reminder picker and run a fired reminder, e.g. **1 (default **)

cooldownMinutes.title: Reminder cooldown (minutes)
cooldownMinutes.description: Minutes between reminder offers in one session; a newly fired reminder is offered at once (default 60)

notify.title: Reminder desktop alert
notify.description: Send a terminal/desktop notification when a reminder fires in an open session (default on)
